## Email series: Automotive
**Trigger:** a Zoho CRM Workflow Rule on Leads (when created, and Industry = Automotive) calls this webhook with body parameters: lead_id, email, first_name, company, token (= the TOKEN constant in the code node).
**Flow:** Email 1 (the checklist download) goes out immediately. After 3 days, if the lead is still 'Not Contacted' and has not opted out, Email 2 goes out; after 4 more days (day 7), under the same condition, Email 3. The email HTML (brand colors, dark-mode safe) is built in the 'Prepare lead' code node.
**Setup:** pick Zoho CRM and Gmail credentials, change TOKEN, activate, copy the Production URL into the Zoho webhook. Set SITE at the top of the code node if the checklist PDFs are served from a different domain.
